label: 🚪 Schema gate
description: Assert that specific columns exist with expected dtypes. Fails the pipeline run if a required column is missing or has the wrong type. Use immediately after an ingest step to catch upstream schema changes early.

expectedTypes.label: Expected dtypes (column:type, comma-separated)
expectedTypes.help: Optional. e.g. customer_id:Int64,order_date:Date,revenue:Float64. Leave blank to skip dtype check.

allowExtraColumns.label: Allow extra columns
allowExtraColumns.help: When false, the gate also fails if the input has columns NOT in requiredColumns.
